thread:
maya (Marketing): Quick sync: need a tiny "decklet" pack + routing snippets for SDRs before the launch email goes out. Target: 1 slide per competitor bucket + 2 SDR lines each.
tess (Product Marketing): Keep it frictionless. One econ line, one engineering line per bucket. No heavy numbers in the hero.
owen (Field): Field note: most prospects ask two things first: 'what will my bill look like?' and 'what happens when the model spikes?'. Rebuts should hit those.
nate (Sales Enablement): I'll make two SDR plays: cold outreach and reply play. Cold opener: "Quick Q: are inference costs annoying to forecast? We map runs to dollars. 15 minutes?" Reply play when they say "we use cloud X": "Totally94we help teams standardize SLAs & avoid surprise spikes. Can I show a side-by-side?"
tess (Product Marketing): Micro-rebuts drafts:
- vs cloud AI: "Predictable unit economics + SLA fallbacks when capacity shifts."
- vs LLM APIs: "Runtime consistency, not just model access."
- vs infra vendors: "Control without the ops headcount."
maya (Marketing): Nice. For the landing hero, two variants: 
A) Econ: "Reduce inference spend. Keep quality."
B) Runtime: "One API for hosted, dedicated, and private."
owen (Field): Routing guidance: if prospect mentions "compliance" -> Private deck, "cost" -> benchmark blog, "self-host" -> dedicated trial, "latency" -> perf demo. Can we ship a copy-paste snippet for Intercom?
maya (Marketing): Yes. Nate, can you add this YAML to the SDR playbook?
nate (Sales Enablement): Dropping a starter snippet (copyable):
```
intent_rules:
  - keyword: "compliance"
    route: "private-deck"
  - keyword: "cost"
    route: "benchmark-blog"
  - keyword: "self-host"
    route: "dedicated-trial"
  - keyword: "latency"
    route: "perf-demo"
```
assets-bot: Assets uploaded -> /drive/marketing/decklets/launch-v3 (permissions: marketing + sales)
tess (Product Marketing): Field ask: include a 20-word example for infra vendor rebut: "Stitching multiple SDKs increased incident MTTR and hidden ops spend. Redwood unifies runtime and reduces integration debt." Keep it short.
maya (Marketing): Action items: 1) @tess: finalize decklets & one-slide appendix about fallbacks (EOD). 2) @nate: add SDR scripts + paste YAML to playbook (today). 3) @owen: 3 field bullets/examples (tomorrow AM). We'll reconvene 11:30 PT to approve. Short thread; reply with edits. :rocket:
